narrative.overview: A high-performance, dark glassmorphism design language built for an elite Game Client Programmer specializing in Systems Architecture, Graphics Pipelines, and AI Reinforcement Learning.
keyCharacteristics: Tactical Dark Space Atmosphere (#050711 with procedural dual nebulae)
Dual Type Stack (Plus Jakarta Sans + Fira Code)

rules.name: The 10% Luminous Rule
rules.body: Saturated electric blue is strictly reserved for key interactive focal points, occupying <=10% of any screen.

rules.name: The Developer Monospace Stamp Rule
rules.body: All metadata, years, execution times, performance figures, and architecture labels must be rendered in Fira Code.

rules.name: The Glass Horizon Rule
rules.body: Floating surfaces must combine backdrop-filter: blur(20px), semi-transparent fill, and a 1px hairline border.

dos: Wrap all architecture notes, algorithms, metrics, and years in Fira Code tags.
Keep cards and dialogs on frosted glass surfaces with hairline borders.
Use GSAP for performance-critical, GPU-accelerated motion with power2.out or power3.out curves.
donts: Don't use generic flat grey shadows or solid opaque #000000 panels.
Don't use decorative color gradients on heading or body text.
Don't use emojis as interface or feature icons. Use typography or clean labels instead.
Don't use overly bouncy, cartoony easing that conflicts with the serious engineering aesthetic.
Don't allow horizontal scroll overflow on mobile viewports.
